dont.en: Do not use generative AI in a task that prohibits it.
dont.zh: 禁止 AI 的任务不得使用生成式 AI。

dont.en: Do not treat no AI training as a zero-retention guarantee.
dont.zh: 不要将不用于训练误解为零留存承诺。

coursework.en: Check each assessment brief for essential, optional or prohibited generative AI use.
coursework.zh: 每项考核须核对 AI 必需、可选或禁止的说明。
coursework.meaningEn: University student GenAI assessment guidance; check each task brief or module handbook and ask your tutor if permission is unclear.
coursework.meaningZh: 诺丁汉大学学生生成式AI考核指引；须查阅每项任务说明或模块手册，如有不明应向导师或课程负责人确认。

exams.en: Specific AI permission for exams remains unverified; consult the exam instructions.
exams.zh: 考试 AI 许可尚未独立核实，应核对该场考试说明。
exams.meaningEn: Official current exam-specific GenAI clauses were not separately retrieved; follow formal exam instructions.
exams.meaningZh: 本次未单独取回现行考试专门AI条款；请严格遵守正式考场与试卷说明。

disclosure.en: Follow the method in the assessment brief; a full chat log is good practice, not invariably required.
disclosure.zh: 按考核说明进行披露；完整聊天记录属于良好实践，不是普遍强制提交要求。
disclosure.meaningEn: Assessment acknowledgement guidance (statement, appendix, in-text acknowledgement, or citation as specified by the assessment brief; keeping prompt logs is good practice).
disclosure.meaningZh: 考核披露指引（按任务说明要求采用声明、附录、文内致谢或引用格式；保存提示词日志属于良好实践建议）。

privacy_data.en: Logged-in university Copilot guidance addresses training use, not total retention.
privacy_data.zh: 学校账号 Copilot 指导只涉及训练用途，不等于零留存。
privacy_data.meaningEn: University Copilot data-handling guidance; enterprise protection means prompts are not used to train foundation models, which is distinct from a zero-retention guarantee.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 学校Copilot数据处理指引；企业数据保护指输入不用于训练基础模型，但不能将其误解为零留存承诺。

approved_tools.en: Copilot is recommended for support outside assessment; availability is not assessment permission.
approved_tools.zh: Copilot 被推荐用于非考核学习辅助；可访问不等于考核许可。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Microsoft Copilot with University login and protected icon for study support; tool availability never grants assessment permission.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 使用学校账号登录且显示保护图标的Microsoft Copilot（用于学习辅助）；工具可用绝不代表考核获准使用。

research_publication.en: No current university-wide research/thesis AI rule independently established.
research_publication.zh: 尚未核实全校适用的科研、论文 AI 规定。
research_publication.meaningEn: Official current research-publication GenAI clauses were not retrieved in this bundle.
research_publication.meaningZh: 本批资料未取回现行专门的科研出版生成式AI条款。

academic_integrity.en: Prohibited AI use in an assessment can constitute false authorship.
academic_integrity.zh: 考核禁止 AI 时使用可能构成虚假作者身份。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Student guidance on prohibited GenAI use as false authorship, plus secondary Students' Union misconduct process guidance (primary 2026–27 Code of Practice text pending verification).
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 关于违规使用生成式AI构成虚假署名（False Authorship）的学生指引，以及学生会二手程序指南（2026–27学年主规章正文待核实）。

teaching_guidance.en: Tutor and module brief specify task-level expectations; AI grading and uploads remain unverified.
teaching_guidance.zh: 导师与课程文件规定任务层面期望；AI 评分和上传尚未核实。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Guidance directing students to clarify permitted AI boundaries with module convenors or tutors.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 引导学生向模块负责人或导师核实AI允许使用边界的教学沟通指引。

security_procurement.en: No current university procurement or security approval rule independently established.
security_procurement.zh: 尚未取得学校当前 AI 安全采购批准规则。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Official current institutional security and procurement clauses were not retrieved in this bundle.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 本批资料未取回现行校级AI安全与采购专门条款。
